# Roleplay Rule 2 - Don't Over-Escalate
Someone calling you stinky is not a good enough reason for you to kill them. You may have conflict with another crew member even as a non antagonist, but there must be a verbal altercation before you exchange blows.
Here is a simplified chain of escalation, where one event permits the next one in the list: - Verbal only -> - Shoving and removal from immediate area -> - Fist fighting, biting, kicking — the brutal workings -> - Weapons and the ability to crit somebody -> - Killing somebody
Remember, killing somebody fully is worse than just hitting someone in the eyes of space law — even worse if you decapitate them. Don’t kill or get killed over petty arguments.
If you feel that a player is over-escalating, send a message in admin help (F1), and the admins will sort that out.
## Precedents
- Insults are not just reasons to murder someone. But you [italic]can[/italic] insult them back, or you could even beat them up depending on the intensity of the insult. - Extreme in-character insults like [textlink="speciesism" link="RuleBigotry"] allow people to skip straight to beating the offender's ass. - Respond with roughly equivalent force, if only a bit stronger. If you get called stinky, you could shove them. If someone shoves you, you could punch them back. If someone stabs you, you could shoot them back. - You should stop fighting as soon as someone is critical. Don't leave them to die, either. [textlink="Killing people outright without sufficient escalation is self-antagging" link="RuleSelfantag"]. (Doing so accidentally is fine, but you should be dragging them to the medbay nonetheless.)
